title: Powers Koszul complexes are perfect and restrict to the unit on a principal-open cover
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, choose $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in A$, and put $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme] and $U=D(f_1)\cup\cdots\cup D(f_r)$. For $e\ge1$, let $K^\bullet(f_1^e,\ldots,f_r^e)$ be the bounded cochain Koszul complex, and define $I^i(f_1^e,\ldots,f_r^e)=K^{i-1}(f_1^e,\ldots,f_r^e)$ for $i\le0$ and $0$ for $i>0$, with differential the negative of the Koszul differential. Let $I_e\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ be the associated object, and let $u_e:I_e\to\mathcal O_X$ be the canonical augmentation from the Koszul triangle. Then every $I_e$ is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and $u_e|_U:I_e|_U\to\mathcal O_U$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08CX (perfect-section-koszul), definition of $I^\bullet$ and the assertion that $I_e\to\mathcal O_X$ becomes an isomorphism on $U$
